## Why

The terminal training scores alone do not answer what quality was actually observed under a fixed resource ceiling, or how much the complete candidate search cost.

## Changes

Add a read-only, SHA-pinned analysis of the original42 and separate C1 curve export. It verifies every report binding, confusion matrix and recorded clock; preserves both learning rates and all seeds; retains missing observations and right-censored target crossings; and charges all six candidates per core. C1 cumulative CPU remains a lower bound and full-attempt RSS remains an upper bound for a prefix.

The plan explicitly labels this as post-terminal descriptive analysis. It executes no model and grants no scientific or training-domain admission.

## Validation

- Five focused behavior tests pass: missing cutoffs, no interpolation, before-training evaluation scope, first strict ties/crossings, incomplete seed rosters and CM denominators.
- Actual data: 49 report hashes, 2,969 confusion matrices and 351 C1 clock intervals verified.
- Seven terminal core rows reconcile with the separately reviewed baseline table and six-HCSN summary.
- A separate reviewer independently reproduced both views, 56 aggregate rows and 336 candidate members using exact rational CM arithmetic, without importing this producer.
- Formatter entry point passed. Remote tree 103dbd2b97c70115a12ee9a4c1a492dad3790b9a matches local fec88f31ae6cd9222f01f0f5e1d7deca11d1423b exactly.

The large immutable inputs, raw outputs, independent review and cost receipts follow in a mechanical evidence archive. Stacked on draft #5838.
